summary: Remediated the reported `No tests found` issue for `bootstrap-nextjs-app`. The Playwright regression spec exists at `.ai_factory/tests/functional/feedback/bootstrap-nextjs-app.spec.ts`, and `npm run test:e2e -- --list` now discovers 1 test in 1 file. I also patched `eslint.config.mjs` to ignore local `.ai_factory/tests/*.cjs` probe scripts and generated report/output paths, so app linting is not broken by ad hoc evidence helpers. Verification run: `npm run lint` passed; `npm run build` passed and prerendered `/`; package script validation passed for `dev`, `build`, `lint`, and `test:e2e`; source boilerplate scan found no default starter copy. Full Playwright execution was attempted again with the default timeout and with `--timeout=90000`; both runs failed while setting up the Playwright `page` fixture, so I cannot claim e2e tests passed.

defects.description: Full Playwright browser execution for the bootstrap home-route regression test does not complete in this environment. Evidence: `npm run test:e2e` reached the single discovered test but failed with `Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while setting up "page"`; retrying with `npm run test:e2e -- --timeout=90000` failed the same way. The original `No tests found` defect is fixed, but the e2e test result is still not passing.
